test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 29 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Based on the English alphabetical order, three of the following four letter-cluster pairs are alike in a certain way and thus form a group. Which pair does not belong to that group?

(Note: The odd one out is not based on the number of consonants/vowels or their position in the letter-cluster.)
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/15d4e688c8bdc2766cb74c67a7c0d12a85a1e60bc448f376b860b7949a5ae586.png] 

The logic followed here is:

Option 1) NJ-MP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95fb00f54cec206b14c77aaab8a852a4f44521e3ce94e7dec32e5bf66af1854f.png] 

Option 2) LH-KN 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/255dc2a70666b51c05e419f5018e982fad34f6b7f841f58e2d71038fb7413262.png] 

Option 3) JF-IL 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5942d1095f0c3f696db197e3b66081d2c3786f4f376ff5cede6c53e1f331e3d7.png] 

Option 4) QM-PR

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1ad38d58ec22d8ea98a438717e1d70748c167634ddf85b68b9bd9dc9a87a7dd7.png] 

Thus, out of all the options 'QM-PR' is the odd one out.

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
